import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')

    'font.family': 'serif',

    return p

              arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->,head_width=0.06,head_length=0.04',
                              connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-3.0',
                              color='#D84315', lw=0.9),

    tc = WHITE if i >= 3 else DARK

colors_sorted = [colors[i] for i in order]

ax_b_bar.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_b_bar.spines['left'].set_visible(False)
ax_b_bar.spines['bottom'].set_color('#999')
ax_b_bar.spines['bottom'].set_linewidth(0.5)

ax_c.set_facecolor(BG)

# Arrows between flow boxes
for i in range(len(flow_boxes) - 1):
    x0 = flow_boxes[i][0] + flow_boxes[i][2]
    x1 = flow_boxes[i + 1][0]

    arrow(ax_b_top, x0 + 0.01, ymid, x1 - 0.01, ymid, c='#555', lw=0.7)

# Lower: Horizontal bar chart of Spearman rho

            'entropy_std', 'entropy_max', 'tail_decay']

              'intermediate', 'stationary', 'stationary']

rho_sorted = [rho_vals[i] for i in order]
colors_sorted = [colors[i] for i in order]
cats_sorted = [categories[i] for i in order]

y_pos = np.arange(len(features_sorted))
bars = ax_b_bar.barh(y_pos, rho_sorted, color=colors_sorted, height=0.65,
                      edgecolor=[c + '88' for c in colors_sorted], linewidth=0.5)

ax_b_bar.set_yticks(y_pos)
# Format feature names nicely
nice_names = {
    'hapax_ratio': 'hapax ratio', 'TTR': 'TTR',
    'entropy_mean': 'entropy mean', 'entropy_min': 'entropy min',
    'entropy_std': 'entropy std', 'entropy_max': 'entropy max',
    'tail_decay': 'tail decay'
}
ax_b_bar.set_yticklabels([nice_names.get(f, f) for f in features_sorted],
                          fontsize=6.5)
ax_b_bar.set_xlabel(r'Spearman $\rho$ with depth', fontsize=7, color=DARK)
ax_b_bar.set_xlim(-0.78, 0.22)
ax_b_bar.axvline(x=0, color='#999', lw=0.5, ls='-', zorder=1)
ax_b_bar.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=6, colors='#666')
ax_b_bar.tick_params(axis='y', length=0)

# Add rho value labels at bar ends
for i, (val, bar) in enumerate(zip(rho_sorted, bars)):
    if val < 0:
        x_text = val - 0.02
        ha = 'right'
    else:
        x_text = val + 0.02
        ha = 'left'
    ax_b_bar.text(x_text, i, f'{val:+.2f}', va='center', ha=ha,
                  fontsize=5.8, color=DARK, fontweight='medium')

# Legend for categories
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [
    Patch(facecolor=C_DRIFT, edgecolor=C_DRIFT, label='Drifting'),
    Patch(facecolor=C_INTERM, edgecolor=C_INTERM, label='Intermediate'),
    Patch(facecolor=C_STAT, edgecolor=C_STAT, label='Stationary'),

ax_b_bar.legend(handles=legend_elements, fontsize=5.5, loc='lower right',
                framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#CCC', handlelength=1.0,
                handletextpad=0.4, borderpad=0.3)

# Style the bar chart axes
ax_b_bar.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_b_bar.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_b_bar.spines['left'].set_visible(False)
ax_b_bar.spines['bottom'].set_color('#999')
ax_b_bar.spines['bottom'].set_linewidth(0.5)

# ── Panel (c): Classification ──
ax_c = fig.add_subplot(gs[2])
ax_c.set_xlim(0, 1); ax_c.set_ylim(0, 1); ax_c.axis('off')
ax_c.set_facecolor(BG)
ax_c.patch.set_alpha(1.0)

# Panel label
ax_c.text(-0.02, 1.06, '(c)', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=DARK,
          transform=ax_c.transAxes, ha='left', va='top')

cx_c = 0.5

# Features input
rbox(ax_c, 0.15, 0.84, 0.70, 0.09, '#FDE8D0', BOX_ORANGE, 0.7)
tx(ax_c, cx_c, 0.885, '7 DDR features', fontsize=6.5, fontweight='bold')

arrow(ax_c, cx_c, 0.83, cx_c, 0.76)

# XGBoost classifier
rbox(ax_c, 0.10, 0.66, 0.80, 0.09, '#E8D4E8', '#6A3D6A', 0.8)
tx(ax_c, cx_c, 0.705, 'XGBoost (LOGO-CV)', fontsize=6.5,
   fontweight='bold', color='#4A2D4A')

arrow(ax_c, cx_c, 0.65, cx_c, 0.57)

# 3-class output boxes
cw_ = 0.20
ch_ = 0.08
cg_ = 0.04
ct_ = 3 * cw_ + 2 * cg_
cx0 = cx_c - ct_ / 2
cy_ = 0.47

for k, (cls, col, tc) in enumerate([
    ('gen-0', DEPTH_FC[0], DARK),

    rbox(ax_c, cxx, cy_, cw_, ch_, col, DEPTH_EC[k * 2], 0.5)
    tx(ax_c, cxx + cw_ / 2, cy_ + ch_ / 2, cls,
       fontsize=6.5, color=tc, fontweight='bold')

tx(ax_c, cx_c, cy_ - 0.05, '3-class output', fontsize=5.5, color='#888')

# LOGO F1 score
rbox(ax_c, 0.15, 0.12, 0.70, 0.12, '#F0F7F0', BOX_GREEN, 0.6)
tx(ax_c, cx_c, 0.18, 'LOGO $F_1$ = 0.694', fontsize=7.5,
   fontweight='bold', color='#2D6A2D')

# ── Vertical separator lines ──
# Draw on figure level
for ax_left, ax_right in [(ax_a, ax_b_top)]:
    pass  # gridspec handles spacing

# ── Save ──
out_dir = '/root/gen-depth-fingerprint/results'
os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig2_framework.png', format='png')
